description: Fix all identified bugs, inconsistencies, and data quality issues across scraper code, tests, configuration, and generated FP1 profile files

userStories.title: Fix XML mapping typo (magnetic_green -> magenta_green)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the monochromatic color magenta-green value to be correctly mapped to the FP1 XML template so that profiles with monochromatic color settings are generated correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: In scrape/models.py, attribute_to_xml_mapping key 'monochromatic_color_magnetic_green' is changed to 'monochromatic_color_magenta_green'
uv run pytest passes
uv run mypy passes
userStories.notes: Line 136 in scrape/models.py. The dataclass field is 'magenta_green' (line 92) but the mapping says 'magnetic_green'. The flattened key from to_flat_dict() will be 'monochromatic_color_magenta_green', so the current mapping never matches.

userStories.title: Fix template path case mismatch
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the Jinja2 template path to match the actual filename on disk so that the scraper works on case-sensitive filesystems (Linux CI).
acceptanceCriteria: In scrape/scraper.py, template_location is changed from 'templates/FP1.jinja2' to 'templates/fp1.jinja2'
uv run pytest passes
userStories.notes: Line 237 in scrape/scraper.py. The actual file on disk is templates/fp1.jinja2 (lowercase). This will fail on case-sensitive filesystems like Linux CI.

userStories.title: Add error handling for exposure_compensation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the exposure_compensation parser to handle missing regex matches gracefully instead of raising an unhandled IndexError.
acceptanceCriteria: In scrape/models.py, exposure_compensation() returns 0.0 and logs a warning when no regex match is found instead of raising IndexError
New pytest test in tests/test_parsing.py covers the no-match case (e.g. passing an empty string or string with no numbers)
uv run pytest passes
userStories.notes: Line 274 in scrape/models.py. Currently does 'return convert_to_float(matches[0])' which raises IndexError if no matches. Follow the same pattern as other parsers (e.g. numerical_value) which log a warning and return a default.

userStories.title: Fix unconditional warning in create_fuji_profile
userStories.description: As a developer, I want create_fuji_profile() to only log a warning when profile creation fails, not on every call.
acceptanceCriteria: In scrape/scraper.py, the warning in create_fuji_profile() is conditional — only logged when profile creation fails (returns None or raises exception)
Successful profile creation does not produce a warning log
uv run pytest passes
userStories.notes: Lines 172-178 in scrape/scraper.py. Currently the logger.warning() is called unconditionally after every FujiSimulationProfile.create_instance() call. Wrap in try/except and only warn on failure, returning None. On success, return the profile without warning.

userStories.title: Add early return on empty tags in get_profile
userStories.description: As a developer, I want get_profile() to return None immediately when no tags are found instead of processing empty data.
acceptanceCriteria: In scrape/scraper.py, get_profile() returns None after logging the error when tags is empty/falsy
uv run pytest passes
userStories.notes: Lines 219-220 in scrape/scraper.py. Currently logs an error when tags is empty but continues to create a FujiSimulationProfileParser with empty tags. Add 'return None' after the logger.error() call.

userStories.title: Fix test imports and monkeypatch targets
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the test files to use correct imports and monkeypatch targets so that tests actually run and validate the code.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_parsing.py uses absolute imports: 'from scrape.models import FujiSensor' and 'from scrape.scraper import FujiRecipes, flatten_and_process_tags' (not relative 'from ..scrape')
tests/test_parsing.py line 142 monkeypatches FujiRecipes.soup_representation (the staticmethod on the class) instead of scraper.soup_representation (nonexistent module-level function)

tests/test_save.py line 52 monkeypatches the actual output path mechanism — either monkeypatch FujiRecipe.output_file_path as a property returning a tmp_path-based path, or monkeypatch os.getcwd to return tmp_path — instead of nonexistent 'scrape.models.OUTPUT_DIR'
Create tests/conftest.py with shared pytest fixtures (e.g. sample_html, strong_tags) that can be reused across test files
All tests pass with 'uv run pytest'
uv run mypy passes
userStories.notes: test_parsing.py uses relative imports (from ..scrape.models) which won't work with pytest from project root. test_save.py tries to monkeypatch scrape.models.OUTPUT_DIR which doesn't exist. Move shared fixtures to tests/conftest.py for reuse.

userStories.title: Fix pyproject.toml configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the project config to reflect the actual Python version and package structure.
acceptanceCriteria: tool.ruff.target-version is updated from 'py311' to 'py313' in pyproject.toml
tool.coverage.run.source is updated from ['fuji_x_weekly_simulation_profiles'] to ['scrape'] in pyproject.toml
uv run ruff check . passes
uv run mypy passes
userStories.notes: Line 53: target-version = 'py311' but requires-python = '>=3.13.0'. Line 112: source references wrong module name.

userStories.title: Fix method name typo and logging inconsistencies
userStories.description: As a developer, I want consistent naming and logging across the codebase.
acceptanceCriteria: scrape/models.py: method 'film_simluation' (line 277) renamed to 'film_simulation'
scrape/models.py: reference in initialise_parsing_methods (line 401) updated from KeyStandardizer.film_simluation to KeyStandardizer.film_simulation
scrape/models.py: add 'logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)' near top of file and replace all bare logging.warning() calls with logger.warning()
scrape/scraper.py: replace logging.warning() call on line 57 with logger.warning()
uv run ruff check . passes
uv run mypy passes
userStories.notes: film_simluation is a typo (missing 'l'). Models.py has no configured logger — it uses logging.warning() directly in multiple places (lines 158, 265, 291, 365, 385). scraper.py mixes logger.warning() and logging.warning().

userStories.title: Fix ColorChromeBlue conditional parsing in scraper
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the scraper to parse sensor-conditional values like 'Off (X-Trans V); Weak (X-Trans IV)' and select the correct value for the current sensor, instead of storing the raw text.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a function in scrape/models.py or scrape/scraper.py that parses semicolon-separated conditional values like 'Off (X-Trans V); Weak (X-Trans IV)' and returns the value matching the given sensor (e.g. for X-Trans-IV returns 'WEAK', for X-Trans-V returns 'OFF')
The color_chrome_effect parsing in KeyStandardizer handles conditional values by accepting an optional sensor parameter or by pre-processing the value before standardization
New pytest fixture in tests/conftest.py provides sample conditional values for testing
New test verifies correct value is selected for X-Trans-IV sensor and X-Trans-V sensor
If no sensor match is found, falls back to the first value with a warning
uv run pytest passes
userStories.notes: Currently 3 FP1 files contain raw text like 'OFF_(X-TRANS_V);_WEAK_(X-TRANS_IV)' in ColorChromeBlue. The scraper needs to know which sensor it's generating for and pick the right value. The sensor is available in FujiRecipe.sensor. The conditional format from fujixweekly.com is typically 'Value1 (Sensor1); Value2 (Sensor2)'.

userStories.title: Standardize FP1 extension and re-scrape all profiles
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to regenerate all FP1 profiles after code fixes, using .FP1 (uppercase) extension to match Fujifilm convention.
acceptanceCriteria: scrape/scraper.py output path in FujiRecipe.output_file_path uses '.FP1' extension instead of '.fp1'
cached/*.txt files are cleared (emptied) to force full re-scrape
make scrape runs successfully and generates profiles in fuji_profiles/
All generated files in fuji_profiles/ use .FP1 extension
No FP1 files contain raw conditional text like 'OFF_(X-TRANS_V);_WEAK_(X-TRANS_IV)'
uv run pytest passes
userStories.notes: This story requires network access to fujixweekly.com. Run 'make clean' to clear cached URLs, then 'make scrape' to regenerate all profiles. Fujifilm X Raw Studio natively produces .FP1 (uppercase). The copy script already handles both cases via case-insensitive matching. Delete old .fp1/.FP1 files before re-scraping to avoid mixed extensions.
